item.title: Bodega's Inventory Impact on Revenue
item.description: In rural Paraguay, it is common for many families to open up a bodega in their house and encounter similar challenges that big market companies face. This project examines the relationship between a bodega, Ña Maria, and her clients, dissecting the small business’s changes in revenue throughout the year. It focuses on identifying ARPU trends, product turnover and wastage, and product contributions to monthly revenues.
